title: Regime Factor Redesign — What Should A01 Actually Measure?
question: A01 currently measures 6 factors (price structure, distribution days, breadth, RS leaders, intermarket, sentiment). BOA-023 showed distribution days have zero predictive value in rising trends (Bulkowski). The core question: what factors SHOULD market regime literally measure? Which current factors should stay, be replaced, or reweighted? Goal: a regime classification system grounded in what empirically predicts forward returns, not inherited assumptions.

current_factors: B: distribution_days (BOA-023: zero predictive value in rising trends per Bulkowski)
approved_but_non_functional: AD line direction (BOA-001, 11 history entries vs 21 needed)
practitioner_consensus_on_regime: Volume behavior at index level (Wyckoff/Lowry accumulation vs distribution)
Credit & liquidity (HY spread, yield curve — Druckenmiller)
not_yet_measured: Volume quality at index level (up-volume vs down-volume ratio)
